$meta.name: Cove design tokens

revision.2.1.0: v0.7 revision 2: (PM: the version is still v0.7; this round is recorded as revision 2.) (1) Theme presets (6: a ground plus a theme color). The default Warm is the gorex warm ground plus the Clay theme color, and Tide becomes its own preset. (2) The theme color is used only for the selected sidebar row and the AI mark (theme/mark); controls and links still follow the system accent. (3) The composer floats completely: the opaque plate is removed, the fade stops at 50%, body text shows below the composer and around it, and an 85% backing plate of the same shape sits under the composer so its own text is not disturbed; every overlay inside the card is clipped to the card corner radius. (4) A standalone settings window (System Settings style, 5 groups). (5) Small-window layout (breakpoints, minimum window 720×520). (6) A confirm dialog (layer/overlay neutral solid, r12).
revision.2.1.1: v0.7 · New Session (PRD §3.3.3): layout.newSession (button, divider, empty-divider ×, Max context control, copy). New Session shortcut is ⇧⌘N (PM). Search Chats stays ⌘K. ⌘F was later given to in-chat find (see 2.1.2).
revision.2.1.2: v0.7 · ⌘F find in the chat (SPEC §18.3): layout.find; ⌘G / ⇧⌘G next / previous; highlight = theme/mark at low opacity; Search Chats stays ⌘K.
revision.2.1.3: v0.7 · providers exist only once added, and same-named models are distinguished (SPEC §11.1–11.2): layout.modelsProviders.optIn / presets / addProvider / custom / emptyState / delete / migrationOptIn; layout.modelPicker; layout.composerNote.
revision.2.1.4: v0.7 · add selected text to the chat (PRD §3.3.3, SPEC §18.4): layout.quote (selection bar, composer quote card, quote in the bubble, send format); new shortcut ⌘L Add to Chat; no new color tokens.
revision.2.1.5: v0.7.0 · auto-generated chat titles (SPEC §20): layout.autoTitle. Motion title/crossfade, title/spin, title/failHold. No new color tokens. The app version stays 0.7.0.

tide/default.replacedBy: theme/mark (per theme; in the Tide preset this is #0E8F81 / #4FE3C1)

layout.composer.fade.plate / fade 92%→88.was: opaque plate under the composer + a 92%/88% fade
layout.composer.fade.plate / fade 92%→88.replacedBy: layout.composer.fade (0 → 50%, then 70% at 10pt from the card bottom) + composer backing

$meta.precedence: tokens.json > html/ prototypes > SPEC.md; Figma is only a historical reference for v0.6
$meta.prd: PRD · Cove v0.7 native macOS style (Linear d90b50e2d8bb)
$meta.colorFormat: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (the last two digits are alpha). Aside from window/base*, every surface is an overlay with alpha; the only exceptions are layer/sheet and layer/overlay (the settings sheet, menus, pop-up menus, dropdowns, and floating panels). Those are opaque solids (alpha = 1), both when the window is active and when it is inactive.

opaqueExceptions.alsoUsedBy: confirm-dialog surface = layer/overlay (v0.7 revision 2; not sampled from the ground)
opaqueExceptions.reason: When a floating layer sits over body text, translucency lets the text underneath show through behind settings rows and menu items (PM review v0.7: settings-dark.png). The PRD now treats this class of layer as the only exception to the no-solid-color rule. The layer/overlayBorder stroke and the shadows shadow.layer/sheet and shadow.layer/overlay stay. The floating composer is not part of that exception: it stays translucent, with a fade along its top edge.
opaqueExceptions.inactive: Inactive values are in color.themes.<id>.inactive.<mode>, also with alpha = 1

$meta.cssVarRule: In a token name, replace / with - and prefix -- (layer/content → --layer-content). Theme block: :root[data-theme=<id>][data-mode=<m>]. Accent block: :root[data-accent=<id>][data-mode=<m>]. Inactive block: [data-window=inactive].

base.$description: Rendering (SPEC §4.5): one continuous gradient (no banded fills, no +1 overlap). OKLab monotone cubic interpolation (Fritsch–Carlson) through 4 stops. Horizontal tint weight smoothstep((x−.35)/.65). Computed in float, then ±1 LSB static blue-noise / 8×8 Bayer dither before quantizing (≤ 1/255, same value on all channels, not animated). One cached bitmap at the window's pixel size; the fade, backing, and composite colors sample the same function. Acceptance: 12 theme×mode shots at 200% show no steps, and no crease at 38%/70%.
base.source: gorex style.go:113–121 paintBackground: three vertical gradient segments (0–38%, 38–70%, 70–100%, each a FillGradient at angle 180) plus a full-window horizontal tint, FillGradient angle 90 from start .35 to end 1

window.reduceTransparency: No separate state: the ground is opaque, composited overlays do not reveal the desktop, and the sheet and menus are already solid colors

warm.name: Warm
warm.note: The original gorex ground (style.go:30–34 / 72–76) plus Clay: hue ~15°, which sits between the ground's pink (~330°) and beige (~45°), so the analogous hues harmonize. It comes from the provider/anthropic #D97757 family used since v0.6

tide.name: Tide
tide.note: The original Tide green #0E9F8F / #4FE3C1, plus a misty teal ground in the same family

neutral.name: Graphite
neutral.note: The v0.7.0 neutral gray ground, with the system indigo as the theme color

color.themeRule: A theme is a ground (the four window/base* color stops plus the horizontal tint) plus the theme color theme/mark. The theme color is used only for the AI thinking and generating marks and for the selected sidebar row (selection/row = theme/mark at 16% / 20%). Buttons, switches, links, and the focus ring still follow the system accent. theme/mark is adjusted automatically until it is at least 3:1 against every sample of that theme's ground and card.

light.link: Mix toward #000 in steps of 2% until the contrast against every theme's composited card color (8 sample points) is at least 4.5:1

dark.link: Mix toward #FFF until the contrast is at least 4.5:1

inactive.button/primary*: falls back to a normal button (control/bg + text/primary)

systemEquivalent.selection/row: selectedContentBackgroundColor (v0.7 revision 2: a light tint of the theme color, not the accent)

color.compositeNote: The card is translucent, and the ground is a four-stop gradient plus a horizontal tint, so the composited card color changes with position. contentFlat is the composited card color at the composer's vertical midline and the card's horizontal midpoint in the reference window (the fallback used by the fade and the plate). contentAtFadeTop and contentAtCardBottom are the values at the top of the fade and at the bottom of the card. The prototype samples the exact position (see SPEC §10).

family.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif

font.hig: macOS HIG: Body 13, Callout 12, Subheadline 11, Title3 15, Title2 17, Title1 22; chat body 14

title/crossfade.note: Temporary title to the generated title, and every later title change. The old and new text cross-fade together, in the sidebar row and the title bar, started in the same frame. Reduce Motion swaps immediately.

title/spin.note: 10pt spinner, stroke 1.5, in the sidebar time column while an explicit Regenerate Title request is in flight.

title/failHold.note: After an explicit Regenerate Title fails, the warning stays in the time column this long, then fades back to the time with actions/fade (120ms).

window.minNote: 720×520: a sidebar of 200 (the narrow tier) plus a card of 512 gives a body column of 464 and a composer of 464, which fits the model picker, Reasoning, and the send button. A card height of 460 leaves about 330pt of list after a 73pt composer and a 14pt bottom inset, and the empty state can scroll as one column. That matches the settings window minimum. The PM's estimate of 480pt height would leave the card at 420 and the list around 290, which cannot hold one empty-state column, so the minimum is 520.

sidebar.collapse: v0.7 does not let the user hide the sidebar (there is no sidebar button in the title bar, and no ⌃⌘S), and it does not hide the sidebar automatically
sidebar.truncation: Chat titles truncate to a single line; the time column is not compressed

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.suggestGrid: 2 columns of minmax(0, 1fr), total width = the body column

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.composerHint: hide (the Return-to-send hint is hidden, and the model name is truncated)

responsive.heightRule: When the card is shorter than 560, the empty state hides the shortcut row. If the empty-state content overflows, it scrolls inside the card (safe centering, so the avatar is not cropped)
responsive.header: The chat title and subtitle truncate to one line; the buttons on the right do not shrink
responsive.composer: The model pop-up button is at most 180 wide and truncates its name; the Reasoning button does not shrink; the send button stays a fixed size

composer.sideInsetRule: max(8, (cardWidth − 720) / 2): 8 when the card is narrower than 736, otherwise the composer is centered at 720.
composer.sideInsetNote: When the card's inner width is 736 or less, the left, right, and bottom insets are all 8, concentric with the r22 card and the r14 composer. When it is wider, the left and right insets center the 720-wide composer and the bottom inset stays at 14. The insets change continuously with width, with no jump at 736.
composer.bottomInsetRule: min(14, the actual side inset): 8 on a small window (equal to the sides), at most 14 on a wide window.
composer.floating: Fully floating: there is no opaque plate, and body text passes under the composer and around it and stays visible

fade.color: the card's composited color at that position (sampled along y; composite.contentFlat is the fallback)
fade.clip: Clip to the card's inner corner radius (r21, the outer r22 minus the 1pt stroke). Every overlay inside the card has to be clipped, and must not paint outside the rounded corner

backing.shape: The same position and the same corner radius as the composer (r14)
backing.note: Under the composer's 0.95 opacity, another plate of the card composite at 85% is added, so body text showing through into the composer is at most 0.75% ((1−0.95)×(1−0.85), at most 2 brightness steps). The composer's own text is undisturbed, and body text outside the composer is still visible

composer.transcriptBottomPadding: composerHeight + bottomInset + 16 (the last item scrolls fully above the composer)

stepper.style: NSStepper up and down arrows, 4pt to the right of the number field

messageActions.copied: status/success text plus a check mark only, no fill, for 1.5s

overlayBorder.appliesTo: menus, pop-up menus, tooltips, jump to latest, and sheets

scroller.style: The system overlay scrollbar (NSScroller overlay), hidden while idle

settingsWindow.kind: A standalone window in the System Settings style, opened with ⌘,. It is a singleton: pressing ⌘, again only brings it forward
settingsWindow.background: The same ground as the main window (the current theme)

sidebar.selection: selection/row (a light tint of the theme color)

pane.card: The same card as the main window (flush under the title bar, 8pt from the right and the bottom, r12, layer/content)

settingsWindow.apply: Applies immediately, which is the macOS settings-window convention. There is no Save or Cancel. Text fields commit on Return or when they lose focus, and show "Saved" with a check mark for 1.5s

chatSettingsSheet.entry: Title-bar More (…) → Chat Settings…; the error card's Open Settings…
chatSettingsSheet.note: Overrides for this chat only (Model, Temperature, Max tokens, Reasoning, System prompt, Extra body, Last request). Save and Cancel stay

messageEdit.width: Message-column width (the same as the body column: min(720, W − 48))
messageEdit.send: ↵ sends immediately (no confirm), deletes the N messages after this one, and regenerates from here.

status.saved: Key saved (a key is stored locally) / Configured (a keyless provider has an address)
status.ok: ✓ Connected (only after the latest Test Connection succeeded; editing the key or Base URL clears it)
status.invalid: Key invalid (only after Test Connection failed, or a real request returned 401/403)

detail.title: provider name
detail.test: inline result: Testing… / ✓ Connected · N models · ms / ⚠ reason

models.onFetchFail: saved or built-in list + inline note

modelsProviders.save: per field on commit (blur / Return / toggle / menu); writes only the current provider; viewing does not write
modelsProviders.migration: keep default model / temperature / max tokens → General › New chats

optIn.list: list only providers that were added, in add order (presets and custom mixed)

emptyState.title: No providers yet
emptyState.subtitle: Add a provider to start chatting.
emptyState.align: centered horizontally and vertically in the list area

addProvider.title: Add Provider
addProvider.why: same push as list → detail; choosing a preset opens that same detail page, and ‹ walks all the way back
addProvider.footnote: You can add the same service more than once — for example a work and a personal account.
addProvider.presetFlow: pushes the detail page (Name prefilled / Base URL empty = official / format / built-in models), Cancel + Add; nothing is saved and Saved is not shown until Add

custom.title: Custom Provider
fields: Base URL (required, a full http(s):// address)
custom.models: if Test succeeds and the provider can list models, fetch them (off by default); otherwise Add model… (on by default)
custom.addEnabledWhen: Name and Base URL are valid

errors.nameTaken: Another provider already uses this name.
errors.baseInvalid: Enter a full URL that starts with http:// or https://

custom.errorStyle: 1px status/danger stroke on the field + right-aligned Label/Small status/danger underneath

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.bodyUsed: {n} chats use models from this provider. They’ll switch to your default model.
delete.bodyUsedSingular: 1 chat uses models from this provider. It’ll switch to your default model.
delete.bodyTail: Its API key is removed from the Keychain.
delete.afterDelete: affected chats switch to the default model plus a one-shot composerNote.switched; the default-model fallback rule is unchanged

keep: the config was edited (Base URL / model toggles / manual models)
referenced by any chat or the default model (including keyless Ollama)
migrationOptIn.drop: the other presets that were never touched (they stay in Add Provider)
migrationOptIn.ids: keep the original id; a later duplicate add uses {presetId}-{n}

settingsLongText.rule: Long-text and JSON fields: the title and the description sit above a full-width field

dialog.surface: layer/overlay (a neutral solid, not sampled from the ground)
dialog.buttons: Two equal-width buttons side by side: Cancel on the left (a normal button, and the default focus) and the destructive button on the right (status/danger fill with white text)
dialog.keys: Esc = Cancel; Return = the default button (Cancel); ⌘⌫ = Delete; Tab moves between the two buttons
dialog.skip: Deleting a chat that has no messages skips the confirmation and deletes it immediately

newSession.$description: PRD §3.3.3 New Session and max context (SPEC §18.2). A divider is an event in the chat JSONL. A request sends the system prompt plus the messages after the last divider.

button.placement: left group of the composer's tool row, after the Reasoning popup (gap = the tool row's gap, 4)

disabled.hover: none (the fill does not change); the tooltip still shows the reason
when: no messages after the last divider (including an empty chat and a divider just inserted)

tooltip.placement: 6 above the button (the composer sits at the bottom of the window)

divider.width: the message column width (same as .turn: min(720, W − 48))

x.reserve: an empty divider reserves 20 (16 + 4) on each side of the label so the label stays centered and does not jump when × appears
x.showWhen: while hovering an empty divider (no messages after it)

copy.settingHint: Rounds per session · a question and its answer = 1 round

maxRounds.count: one question and its answer = 1 round; the system prompt does not count; only rounds after the last divider count
maxRounds.control: popup button (Unlimited / Limit to); choosing Limit to shows a 44-wide field, a 13×22 stepper, and the unit rounds to its right; Unlimited shows only the popup
maxRounds.global: Settings › General › New chats (after Max tokens): written into the JSONL header when a new chat is created
maxRounds.perChat: Chat Settings sheet › Generation (after Max tokens), the same control, applied on Save

auto.rule: before send: if rounds after the last divider are already ≥ maxRounds, insert an automatic divider, then send

editResend.rule: editing a message from before a divider and resending deletes the later messages and dividers together; N in "Replaces N later messages" counts messages only; dividers fade to 40% with the later content and are deleted

data.header: maxRounds: null | 1–100 (missing = null = Unlimited; old chats stay as they are)

find.$description: ⌘F find in the chat (added in PRD §3.3.3, SPEC §18.3). Sidebar search stays ⌘K.

bar.position: top of the main card (under the title bar), full width of the card, clipped to the card radius
bar.zIndex: above the list and the fade, below menus

field.style: same as the settings text field: control/field + control/fieldBorder; focus ring same as .field

done.label: Done
done.style: text button (same as the editor Cancel), height 24

bar.transcriptTopPadding: 24 + 32 (the top message stays clear of the find bar while it is open)

backing.note: same backing as the composer: body text passing under the find bar does not show through

row.header: sender (You / Cove) Label/SmallMedium primary + time Caption/Meta tertiary
row.snippet: Label/Small secondary, at most 2 lines, the match in bold text/primary, ellipses before and after
row.selected: solid accent/default + text/onAccent (sender, time, snippet, and bold all use onAccent, same as a selected menu row)

keys.↵ / click: jump there and dismiss the list

highlight.note: every match = theme color at low alpha, the current match darker; no yellow; text color unchanged (primary / code/text / bubble/userText stay ≥ 4.5 on top, measured by validate08)

currentRing.note: the current match also gets a 1px inner stroke (theme color at 55%); depth of color is not the only distinction

jump.scroll: center the match in the visible area between the find bar's bottom edge and the composer's top edge

flash.target: a user message = the bubble; an AI message = the whole reply (including the 8/12 outset, radius 10)
flash.paint: a rounded halo outset by 8 plus an inner overlay of the same color (inset box-shadow; the bubble fill is not replaced)
flash.note: dark peak 8%: stacked on the current match at 32%, user-bubble text still ≥ 4.5 at worst (Tide dark 4.60)

include: every message (including history from before a New Session divider)
AI replies (including code blocks, tables, and quotes)
exclude: a reply that is still generating (included once it finishes)
divider labels, times, and button text
code-block title rows (language name, Copy) and every button's text
scope.match: plain text, case-insensitive, no regex; matches the rendered text (not Markdown syntax characters such as ** ` #)

modelPicker.label: {model}
modelPicker.duplicateWhen: the current model name exists under ≥ 2 enabled providers (connected, and that model is on)
modelPicker.truncate: truncate the model name first; never truncate the provider name

menu.opens: the side with more room (upward at the composer), staying inside the window; the component is layout.menu
menu.search: a search field at the top when there are ≥ 10 models (layout.menu.search)

composerNote.$description: a one-line note above the composer (SPEC §11.2)

noProvider.text: Add a provider to start chatting.

switched.once: dismissed by × or by the next message sent in that chat, and it does not come back

quote.$description: Add selected text to the chat (PRD §3.3.3, SPEC §18.4). Selecting text in a message → the Add to Chat ⌘L bar → a quote card in the composer; on send it goes in front of the body as a Markdown quote.

button.label: Add to Chat · Body/UI text/primary
button.hint: ⌘L · Label/Small 12 text/tertiary (§8 keyboard-symbol alignment; ink gap Chat→⌘ is 8, ⌘→L is 1pt; offsets are not hard-coded)

bar.flip: if it does not fit above (bar top is < 8 from the top of the visible area) → 8 below the selection's last line; the bar stays ≥ 8 from the top of the visible area
bar.compact: card content width < 560: hide the ⌘L hint
bar.a11y: role toolbar; the button's VoiceOver label is "Add selection to chat"
bar.position: centered horizontally on the selection's first line (the union of selected fragments on that line); 8 above the first line by default; the bar stays ≥ 8 from the top of the visible area, otherwise it flips to 8 below the last line

card.source: Caption/Meta 11/14 (fixed line height 14) text/tertiary "Cove · 09:41" / "You · 09:40"; no extra gap before the body; omitted when the quote spans messages

remove.position: top right (4 from the right, 4 from the top)
remove.label: Remove quote

height.note: 5 + 14 + 15×line count + 6; the composer's height estimate must use the real height

limits.dedupe: dedupe by text (whitespace folded); a duplicate flashes the existing card for 600ms
limits.note: at most 5 (PM); a single quote has no length cap and is sent in full

bubble.position: inside the bubble, above the body
bubble.style: same as the composer quote card, without ×
bubble.expand: click to expand the full text

send.format: each quote is prefixed with "> " per line (a blank line is a single ">", no trailing space); code quotes keep their ``` fences; a blank line between quotes, and between the quotes and the body; quotes come before the body; the full text is sent
send.storage: JSONL user message quotes: [{text, src, time, code, lang, msgId}]; text stores the body only

quote.draft: quotes are saved with the draft: they survive switching chats and relaunch; a draft with no text but with quotes is kept
quote.find: ⌘F does not search quote-card text (the original text in the chat is still found)
quote.selectionAfterAdd: clear the selection when the engine allows it; if it cannot, the highlight may stay, but the bar closes and the same selection does not pop again; ⌘L again takes the dedupe path
quote.constants: the implementation may write these sizes as constants, provided each one matches this section

menu.$description: In-app popover menu (SPEC §11.3, v0.7): every menu opened from a control inside the window shares this one drawn popover. Right-click menus and the macOS menu bar stay on the system menu.
native: right-click menus (open at the pointer, not clipped, the system convention)
menu.maxWidthNote: 300 by default; the model menu keeps layout.modelPicker.menu.maxWidth 300
menu.truncate: one line, ellipsis "…" at the end

row.highlightInset: fills the content width inside the 5pt padding

current.indicator: a check only (accent/default); the text is unchanged and there is no fill

highlight.shared: hover and the keyboard share one highlight
highlight.onOpen: lands on the current item (the current item is blue when the menu opens; that is intended)

groupHeader.dotPlacement: in the check column (the model menu's provider status dot, same color as the list row; status/warning when the key is unavailable)

position.direction: opens toward the side of the anchor with more room; a composer chip opens upward
position.align: leading edge aligned to the anchor's leading edge, kept inside the window
position.scroll: the content scrolls, with the system overlay scrollbar and no up/down arrows
position.openScroll: on open the current item is visible, centered when it can be

motion.note: reuses actions/fade at 120ms; no new motion token

search.thresholdRule: shown when there are ≥ 10 models; fewer than 10 has no search field
search.match: model name or provider name, case-insensitive substring
search.footerPinned: "Models & Providers…" stays pinned at the bottom, outside the scroll, with a separator above it
search.keys: focus stays in the search field: ↑↓ move the highlight, Return selects it; the first Esc clears, and Esc on an empty field closes

keyboard.move: ↑↓ (skip group headers and disabled rows), Home / End, PageUp / PageDown
keyboard.typeSelect: menus without a search field: typing letters jumps to the first prefix match

close: click outside the menu (that click is eaten and is not delivered below, same as macOS)
the window loses focus (it is not restored when the window is focused again)

focusAfterClose.composerChip: choosing from a composer chip returns to the composer

a11y.item: menuitem; a checkable row is menuitemcheckbox with the checked state

menu.inactiveWindow: not used: the menu closes when the window loses focus

autoTitle.description: Auto-generated chat titles (SPEC §20). Ships in v0.7.0. Default on. One short background request per chat after the first reply. A manual rename is never overwritten. Regenerate Title is the explicit overwrite. No new color tokens.

generation.width: grapheme clusters; East Asian Wide and Fullwidth count as 2
generation.maxOutputTokensNote: Every title request uses 256. Reasoning models count thinking toward the cap, and a name check misses families. The client still cuts the title to 30 width units.

settings.toggleHint: Sends the first message and reply to the title model.
settings.modelHint: Same as Chat uses each chat’s own model.
settings.unavailable: Unavailable — titles use each chat’s model.
